import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
print(df['ChargeCategory'].unique())
sub = df[(df['ChargePeriodStart'].astype(str).str.startswith('2026-07')) & (df['ChargeCategory']=='Usage')]
print(len(sub))
g = sub.groupby('SubAccountName')['BilledCost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
total = g.sum()
print(g/total*100)

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
sub = df[(df['ChargePeriodStart'].astype(str).str.startswith('2026-07')) & (df['ChargeCategory']=='Usage')]

top, share = g.idxmax(), round(g.max()/g.sum()*100, 2)
